what_this_discharges: the flag comment at tt_bio/tenstorrent.py:1316 says 'NOT bit-exact, same reason as K3: k_chunk sets the online-softmax reduction order. The accuracy arm is plDDT.' This is that arm, at 298 aa on Blackhole p300c.
source: perf/c14_land/bandk_accuracy_298.json, production protocol (200 sampling steps), qb2 card 1, extracted not re-folded
direction: HIGHER plDDT with the flag ON, i.e. the accuracy arm moves in the flag's favour
why_the_spread_is_zero: both base folds returned the identical CIF digest and both on folds returned the identical digest, so this fold is deterministic at fixed flags. The A/A spread is exactly 0.000000, not a small number.
not_vacuous: the two arms write DIFFERENT digests (a8c6fd65 vs d4667bd5), so the lever provably ran. A byte-identical pair would have made the reading worthless -- negative-control-must-break-what-check-reads.
contrast_with_the_silu_withdrawal: TT_BIO_UNFUSED_SILU was withdrawn on a 0.05088/0.07210 CA-lDDT loss with the arms fully rank-separated. K4 moves plDDT +0.001414 in the GOOD direction against a 0.000000 base spread, i.e. 36x smaller in magnitude and the opposite sign.
still_owed_before_this_flag_can_ship: the fold-level A/B with its own A/A floor on current main. NOT taken: four passes, no clean timing window on qb2.

the flag's own comment sets the bar as 'its fold-level A/B and plDDT arm land on BOTH architectures'. This plDDT arm is Blackhole only. The Wormhole half needs the galaxy, which this row has no grant for.
